description.value: Gulf Island Seaplanes is an Indigenous-owned floatplane airline offering scheduled service between Vancouver International Airport (YVR) and Gabriola Island, DeCourcy Island, Maple Bay, and seasonal Hornby Island flights. For touring cyclists exploring the Gulf Islands, the airline provides a practical way to skip lengthy ferry connections and reach remote island destinations directly by air. Charter services are also available for custom itineraries along the coast of British Columbia.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (covered) at 41m; rack at 45m; rack at 50m; stands (covered) at 51m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Gulf Island Seaplanes is an actively operating, Indigenous-owned floatplane service with year-round scheduled routes between Vancouver (YVR) and several Gulf Islands, plus private charters. No bike-specific amenities (parking, showers, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all cycling criteria default to null. Contact details come entirely from the website since the OSM record carries no phone, address, or confirming tags.
concerns: OSM record has no osm_id, phone, or address tags; all contact details sourced solely from the website.

OSM lat/lon (49.29045, -123.1175) places this near the YVR floatplane dock in Richmond, but the corporate mailing address is in Ladysmith BC. The coordinates likely reflect the YVR terminal rather than the head office.
Bike transport policy (whether bicycles can fly as cargo) is not mentioned on the website and may be worth clarifying for the directory.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating Indigenous-owned airline with year-round scheduled floatplane service — directly useful to island-hopping touring cyclists as a transport option.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website lists a secure luggage holding facility at YVR for passengers with excess baggage, but this is a passenger service feature, not a general public bag-storage amenity. Passenger assistance ramps are available at Silva Bay, Maple Bay, and YVR terminals.

wow_evidence: Indigenous-owned scheduled floatplane airline to the Gulf Islands — primarily a transport service; the flight itself is scenic (charter ladder 1/2). Useful bike+fly connection noted.
blurb: Indigenous-owned floatplane airline flying from YVR to the Gulf Islands.
